snippet.title: Inferno Wizards Gameplay v0.8.0
snippet.description:
Agar.io mixed with World Of Warcraft! 

Inferno Wizards is a multiplayer action RPG with permadeath. In progress demo footage - feedback is welcome!
Checkout the site to play! https://infernowizards.netlify.com/
